How do you manage your citations?🗒️ 

If you are curious about changing the way you save your references, you should join us on Thursday, September 24th for a workshop on Zotero!

What is Zotero? Zotero is a free, citation management tool that automates saving articles, book chapters, and more to use in your future research project. 

We'll be in-person for this one and there will be snacks!🍿🧃  

Register here: https://iu.libcal.com/event/17602309
